# Nothing is built yet, so I haven't written the methodology description

This skill describes a working method so that an external reviewer can critique it. The filing-index ingestion system has no working part yet, so there is no method to describe. Here is what's in the repo:

- **All four packages are `uv init` stubs.** Each `__init__.py` holds only the generated `hello()` function. Each `pyproject.toml` has `dependencies = []` and the placeholder description. The READMEs are empty.
- **The root script entry is broken.** It points to `sec_edgar:main`, but no `sec_edgar` module exists.
- **There are no tests.** No discovery, collection, parsing, reconciliation or publication code exists.
- **The only design content is in `specs/`.** `sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec.md` is marked **PROPOSED (2026-10-05), pending design acceptance**, and there is a companion ADR.

A description written now would just restate that proposed spec as math. The critique would then judge a design nobody has run against real SEC indexes. The critique step is meant to come after the system is built.

## Next step

Use **derive-roadmap's New-Project Entry**, with the spec and ADR as input. It lays out the stages for building the system, starting with accepting the ADR and spec (§7 step 1). In a fresh session, say:

> "Use derive-roadmap (New-Project Entry) on specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec.md, with specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-adr.md as background."

## A mismatch to settle during roadmapping

The spec says "No repository was supplied" and proposes a single `packages/sec-edgar-ingest/` package holding discovery, downloader, parser, manifest, workflows, publisher and CLI. The repo instead has four workspace packages: `sec-edgar-client`, `sec-edgar-download`, `sec-edgar-index-ingest` and `sec-edgar-ingest`. The spec never mentions this split. Decide whether the code follows the four-package layout or the spec's single package before the first stage is planned.

Once the system works end to end on real data, come back and ask for the methodology description again. The design to critique will then be its record identity and precedence rules, withdrawal gating and per-quarter publication.
